Bug_Details:
AsyncCallable should not return a null Future, only a Future whose result is null. Methods like Futures.whenAllComplete(…).callAsync(…) will throw a
NullPointerException if the provided AsyncCallable returns a null Future. To
produce a Future with an output of null, instead return immediateFuture(null).
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where a null Future is returned instead of returning a CompletableFuture with a null result. This will cause a NullPointerException when trying to get the result of the future.
Trigger_Explanation: The test calls the showBug method, which returns a null Future. When result.get() is called on this null Future, it triggers a NullPointerException.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that the test passed without throwing a NullPointerException, which contradicts the expectation set in the test code. Therefore, the test results do not confirm that the bug was triggered.
